expectations.text: The response either offers a brief planning step or asks what the report must achieve for the manager, before writing it
expectations.evidence: Before drafting, it asks: “这份周报交上去之后，主管会拿它做什么决定——放你继续、给你人/资源、还是评判你？”

expectations.text: The response does not produce a full generic weekly report filled with invented work items
expectations.evidence: The response contains planning suggestions and questions, with no drafted work accomplishments. It requests actual materials: “本周的 PR/commit/工单列表、上周周报、团队模板——有哪个就贴哪个。”
